The Operational Bottleneck

Manual document processing slows business down.

Every business document arrives as an isolated fragment of data. When teams rely on manual transcription and fragmented email reviews, operational friction compounds rapidly across the entire organization.

01

Repetitive data entry

Employees repeatedly transfer supplier names, dates, amounts, and line items into spreadsheets or accounting systems.

Hours drained on mechanical transcription instead of financial analysis.
02

Inconsistent document formats

Documents from different suppliers vary drastically in layout, terminology, scan resolution, and structural density.

Rule-based legacy OCR scripts break when layouts shift by even a few pixels.
03

Errors and missing information

Incorrect totals, missing purchase order numbers, and inconsistent line items can create compounded reconciliation work.

Downstream ledger pollution requiring expensive manual reversals.
04

Duplicate invoice risk

Businesses struggle to identify invoices that appear to have been submitted more than once across dispersed email threads or branches.

Direct financial leakage from duplicate vendor disbursements.
05

Time-consuming verification

Comparing invoices against purchase orders, delivery notes, and tax records requires tedious side-by-side manual cross-checking.

Delayed vendor payments, strained supplier credit terms, and missed early-pay discounts.
06

Limited operational visibility

Without structured records, it becomes harder to identify unresolved discrepancies, unapproved commitments, and incomplete documentation.

Finance teams operate with retrospective blind spots rather than real-time clarity.
REGISTER // 03

System Architecture

MyLedgerLens

MyLedgerLens is an AI-native document intelligence platform that helps businesses turn unstructured financial paperwork into structured, reviewable information.

MyLedgerLens has a working invoice-processing workflow that uses AI to extract structured information, applies validation checks, and supports human review of potential discrepancies.

The platform unites AI-powered document comprehension with deterministic business logic: automatically extracting line items, verifying arithmetic balances, flagging duplicate submissions, and surfacing discrepancies before records reach downstream review.

Built to support professionals, not replace them.

MyLedgerLens is intentionally designed to augment existing finance, operations, and bookkeeping teams. It automates tedious mechanical transcription while keeping authorized human decision-makers in complete control of financial approvals.

++

WORKING MVP PIPELINE

AI-Assisted Extraction

Google Gemini 2.5 Flash extracts supplier details, invoice numbers, line items, taxes, and totals from uploaded documents.

Deterministic Rules & Duplicate Flagging

Arithmetic checks, required field validation, and workspace-scoped duplicate detection run on every document.

Human Review & CSV Export

Flagged invoices go into a review queue. Operators inspect, correct, approve or reject, and export approved records to CSV.

Operating Sequence

From invoice upload to review-ready data

MyLedgerLens's working MVP establishes a clean, repeatable path from raw invoice documents to structured, validated, and human-reviewed financial records.

01

Upload

Upload a supported invoice document through the existing workspace.

PDF, PNG, and JPEG formats accepted. Documents are stored in encrypted workspace storage.

PHASE // 01 • VERIFIED
02

Extract

AI identifies invoice details such as supplier, invoice number, dates, line items, taxes, and totals.

Powered by Google Gemini 2.5 Flash multimodal vision extraction.

PHASE // 02 • VERIFIED
03

Validate

Deterministic checks identify arithmetic inconsistencies, date issues, and other supported validation concerns.

Arithmetic cross-sum verification, date sanity checks, and workspace-scoped duplicate detection.

PHASE // 03 • VERIFIED
04

Review and decide

Review extracted fields and flagged issues, correct information where supported, and approve or reject the invoice.

Approved records can be exported to CSV. Human decision required before any record is finalized.

PHASE // 04 • VERIFIED

CSV Export: Approved invoice records can be exported to structured CSV files with active protection against formula injection.

Core Philosophy

More than text extraction. A smarter document workflow.

Generic OCR tools dump unverified text strings into raw database tables. MyLedgerLens is founded on the principle that in finance, accuracy without verification is an operational liability.

Evidence-Backed Information

Where supported, extracted fields should be traceable to their location in the original document, making review faster and preserving a verifiable audit trail for every single figure.

Verification Over Blind Automation

Uncertain values, arithmetic discrepancies, and term variances should be flagged explicitly for review rather than silently guessed or accepted without confirmation.

Human-Controlled Decisions

AI assists with information processing. Authorized people retain control over financial approvals, discrepancy resolutions, and consequential downstream postings.

Business Value

Spend less time entering data. More time understanding it.

Financial paperwork should inform decision-making, not stall it. By modernizing document capture and verification, businesses establish a cleaner operational foundation.

Reduce repetitive manual entry

Automate the routine extraction of invoice headers, line-item tables, and tax summaries so operational staff can focus on higher-value vendor relations and reconciliation.

Improve the consistency of financial records

Eliminate typographical mistakes, reversed digits, and inconsistent vendor naming conventions through automated reference matching and validation rules.

Make document review more organized

Replace ad-hoc email threads and desk piles with an auditable queue that clearly prioritizes pending verifications and tracks approval histories.

Identify possible discrepancies earlier

Catch price mismatches, tax miscalculations, and unexpected payment term alterations before invoices are signed off and disbursed.

Prepare structured data for downstream workflows

Generate clean, normalized CSV exports formatted for bookkeeping, spreadsheet analysis, and financial reporting workflows.

Improve visibility into document-processing tasks

Gain real-time clarity into pending liabilities, document cycle times, and unresolved supplier inquiries without waiting for end-of-month closings.
